use_external_rag_runtime.title: Use External RAG Runtime
use_external_rag_runtime.description: Enable planner/runtime/traces path. When false, fallback to legacy pipeline.

allow_legacy_fallback.title: Allow Legacy Fallback
allow_legacy_fallback.description: When true, fallback to legacy hardcoded pipeline only if external runtime fails.

defaults.title: External RAG Defaults
defaults.description: Default constraints applied when request does not specify explicit values.

execution.title: Execution
execution.description: Primary retrieval budgets and content boundaries.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Response language hint (auto, en, pt-BR, etc.).

recency_days.title: Recency Days
recency_days.description: Prefer recent sources within this window. 0 disables recency filter.

max_links_to_open.title: Max Links To Open
max_links_to_open.description: Max candidate links opened for reading.

max_docs.title: Max Docs
max_docs.description: Max documents retained as evidence for synthesis.

max_total_chars.title: Max Total Chars
max_total_chars.description: Global text budget across all read documents.

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Overall step limit for legacy-compatible execution safeguards.

latency_budget_ms.title: Latency Budget (ms)
latency_budget_ms.description: Hard latency budget before planner/runtime stops trying providers.

retry.title: Retry
retry.description: Retry and backoff policy for transient provider failures.

max_retries.title: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retry count for retryable provider errors.

retry_backoff_base_ms.title: Backoff Base (ms)
retry_backoff_base_ms.description: Initial backoff delay in milliseconds (0 disables wait).

retry_backoff_jitter_ms.title: Backoff Jitter (ms)
retry_backoff_jitter_ms.description: Random jitter added to each retry delay.

provider_limits.title: Provider Limits
provider_limits.description: Upper bounds for provider fan-out and attempt pressure.

max_fallback_depth.title: Max Fallback Depth
max_fallback_depth.description: Fallback providers considered after primary attempts.

max_provider_attempts_per_step.title: Attempts Per Step
max_provider_attempts_per_step.description: Per-step attempt cap for each provider.

max_provider_attempts_global.title: Attempts Global
max_provider_attempts_global.description: Global attempt cap for each provider across the run.

prefer_modular_providers.title: Prefer Modular Providers
prefer_modular_providers.description: When true, prefer external provider capabilities over the unified web domain provider when available.

replan.title: Replan
replan.description: Cross-domain recovery behavior when initial routing yields no evidence.

allow_replan.title: Allow Replan
allow_replan.description: Permit explicit broad-recovery replan when initial plan returns no evidence.

control_plane.title: Provider Control Plane
control_plane.description: Operational runtime overrides and scorecards applied by planner without contract changes.

scorecard.description: Provider runtime scorecard map by provider id.
